title: Import choices
decision: Spreadsheets in .xlsx and CSV read without a new dependency, with limits against hostile files; columns name, phone, amount, promised date and note; at most 2 000 rows; a row matching more than one customer blocks the import instead of being guessed; applying names the plan the person saw and is refused if it changed; an undo is all or nothing and refused once a payment was recorded against the imported debt; the rows are kept only in the uploaded file, which is deleted once the import is applied or discarded
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 53
rationale: REQ-062 and REQ-063 name the steps, not the format, the matching or what an undo may still do
